title: Skill Group
description: The grouped sheet, an optional variant for a lighter tabletop sheet (docs/core/progression.md#the-grouped-sheet-variant). Every skill is a member of exactly one group. On a grouped sheet a member skill reads its own skill_start plus its group's ranks; a skill in an untracked group reads its skill_start alone. A full sheet ignores this collection.

skills.description: The member skills, as core:skill/<key> refs. validate.py checks that every core skill is in exactly one core group.

is_tracked.description: Whether a grouped sheet holds ranks for this group. An untracked group (the armor skills) cannot be bought; its members read their skill_start.
